verdict.rationale: Basecamp's own feature docs say to-do lists support subtasks, which covers the work-breakdown half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows any way to link dependent or blocking tasks; Hill Charts and the timeline view show progress and overlaps, not dependencies. missing for 10: dependency/blocking links between tasks, any visualization of blocking order, in-depth subtask documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can break work into subtasks and link dependent tasks so blocking order is clear

citations.quote: Assign items, set due dates, attach files, even create subtasks.
